tobby_1.m: Oh good, somebody comes to help me. Hey kid!

tobby_10.m: My father had sent me to look for him. But I dare not pass the kobolds in the ravine.
r: You are sure your brother went that way?

tobby_12.m: Absolutely. Once he was told of a lovely village hidden in the forest to the southeast.

tobby_14.m: Since then not a single day passed when he didn't talk about it.

r: And you neither dare pass the kobolds, nor tell your father that you give up.

tobby_19.m: You have come from the south, so you know how to pass these nasty kobolds, right?

tobby_2.m: I am Tobby. Please, you must help me.
r: I am $playername. What can I do for you?

tobby_20.m: I am glad you want to help me.
r: Sure thing. We brother-seekers must stand together.

tobby_22.m: I want to get some provisions from the house, just a second ...
r: Go ahead, I'll wait and when you are ready, you can follow me. We will head south.
OK. And tell your father that his rat problem is solved.
OK. And bring your father this loaf of bread.

tobby_3.m: I can't seem to find my brother, Sobby. He hasn't been back since he left last year.
r: Never mind, he will probably not be back too soon.
Also here, bring him a loaf of bread.

tobby.10: On the road to Feygard I have met a boy named Tobby. He is looking for his brother Sobby.
tobby.20: I have promised to help Tobby get past the kobolds to the south.
tobby.21: I have killed the rat in Tobby's garden.
tobby.22: I gave Tobby a loaf of bread for his father.
tobby.23: Tobby has followed me to the beginning of the ravine with the kobolds.
tobby.24: Tobby has made it through the ravine.
tobby.25: Tobby followed me further to the south.
tobby.30: I have attacked poor Tobby, but he ran away. Now he will never find his brother.
tobby.40: We have parted. Tobby was sure now to find his brother.
tobby.50: I have met Tobby again, together with Sobby in the little village in the woods.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
